# QRCode

**Class:** `UltraCanvasQRCode` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/QRCode/UltraCanvasQRCode.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/QRCode/UltraCanvasQRCode.h) · `#include "Plugins/QRCode/UltraCanvasQRCode.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A QR code

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasQRCodeExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasQRCodeExamples.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasQRCode(const std::string& identifier = "QRCode", int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 200, int h = 200);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

This class declares no callbacks of its own.

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
